title: per-tenant-soft-degrader-and-graceful-circuit-lockdown
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Introduces a per-tenant soft degradation controller and a graceful circuit-lockdown mode to reduce noisy tenant-induced circuit flips. Safely rollout behind feature flag; default off for existing clusters.
description:
Summary: Implement a per-tenant soft degrader and a graceful circuit lockdown path to reduce oscillation during tenant spikes and reduce noisy cross-tenant impact. The change introduces a new lightweight controller that applies transient SLO concessions (soft-degrades) per-tenant and a circuit 'lockdown' state that prevents repeated reopen/close cycles for regional circuits.

Motivation: During recent incidents (SUP-8921) a handful of noisy tenants triggered frequent circuit flips in region controllers which caused cascading evictions and long tail latency for unrelated tenants. Existing global shedder rules were too coarse (tenant-blind) and the circuit reopening policy was too aggressive for tenants with sporadic bursts.

Design:
- Per-tenant soft degrader: maintains a short-lived budget that can be spent to allow lower-quality responses (shorter generations, cached fallbacks) for traffic from a tenant when their recent error/latency rate exceeds a threshold. This is tier-aware (free/standard/enterprise) and configurable via runtime flags and the operator console.
- Graceful circuit lockdown: when a circuit detects N flips within a window, it transitions into LOCKDOWN instead of immediately reopening. While LOCKDOWN it only allows probes at an exponentially backed-off cadence and uses hedged routing to healthy regions for affected tenants. This prevents rapid reopen/close cycles and gives KV caches time to stabilize.
- Probation windows: tenants that enter soft-degrade are put into a short probation where the controller evaluates quality regressions against saved prompt-sets before restoring full service.
- Metrics & traces: new metrics added: tenant_soft_degrade{tenant,tier,state}, tenant_degrade_budget_seconds_remaining, circuit_lockdown_duration_seconds, circuit_lockdown_probes_total. All probes are traced with a `degrade.reason` tag for correlation.

Implementation notes:
- Runtime: changes in runtime core to expose a lightweight token-bucket per-tenant used by the degrader, plus a lockdown flag on circuit objects.
- Control plane: admin API for temporarily raising budgets and clearing lockdowns.
- Config: feature-flag gated (runtime.feature.per_tenant_degrader) with default OFF; rollout planned as a gradual percentage opt-in.

Commits (high level):
- 3 commits: initial controller and metrics (adds core logic), runtime integration and lock state plumbing, tests and console controls.

Files changed (high level):
- runtime/circuit/circuit_state.go (new LockdownState enum and probe scheduling)
- runtime/tenant/degrader.go (token-bucket logic, probation timers)
- controlplane/api/tenants_api.go (admin endpoints)
- console/ui/tenant_overview.tsx (new UI controls)
- telemetry/metrics_registry.go (metric registration)
- tests/* (unit + integration harness updates)

Testing:
- Unit tests added for degarder logic and lockdown backoff.
- Integration test added to perf-canary that simulates tenant spike and asserts no >3 circuit flips in 5m window.
- Manual e2e: deployed to staging and drove a noisy-tenant workload; observed 60% reduction in circuit flips and 20% lower eviction churn.

Rollout plan:
1) Feature flag OFF in production.
2) Enable for 5% of tenants (opt-in) and monitor tenant_soft_degrade metrics and eviction rates.
3) Expand to 25% after 48h if no regressions.
4) Enable default ON for new clusters after 2 weeks and for existing clusters by admin choice.

Backout: feature flag OFF immediately disables degrader and any tenants in probation are restored to full service; LOCKDOWN flags cleared by admin endpoint if necessary.

Related: ENG-4192 (investigation), ENG-4210 (console controls), SUP-8921 (incident).

Checklist:
- [x] Core algorithm implemented
- [x] Unit tests
- [x] Integration test in perf-canary
- [x] Metrics/tracing added
- [x] Console controls wired
- [x] Feature-flag gating
- [x] Docs stubbed (console/ops runbook)

Review conversation:
- Arjun Patel (reviewer) 2026-02-26: "This looks promising. Two asks: (1) can we make the default probation window configurable per tier? (2) add a guard to avoid soft-degrading enterprise tenants unless their absolute error rate exceeds a stricter threshold."
- Maya Chen (author) 2026-02-26: "Responding: both items addressed. probation window is now tier-configurable with sensible defaults, and enterprise threshold added (enterprise_min_err_pct). Updated tests to cover the enterprise path."
- Sofia Martinez (reviewer) 2026-02-27: "Can you add an instrumentation event when we skip a probe because lockdown is active? Helps correlate with probe traffic."
- Maya Chen 2026-02-27: "Added metric and trace tag: circuit_lockdown_probe_skipped_total and `probe.skipped_reason=lockdown` on trace spans."
- Ben Carlson (approver) 2026-03-01: "Good to go once CI is green and the console change is smoke-tested."

CI and reruns:
- First CI run (2026-02-28): failed unit test in degrader edge-case (token bucket underflow).
- Fix pushed in commit 3 (2026-02-28).
- Second CI run: all checks passed (unit, integration, lint).

Performance: perf-canary run shows:
- circuit flips reduction: 3.4x fewer flips for simulated noisy tenant
- eviction churn reduced: 21%
- p99 latency for unrelated tenants unchanged within noise

Merge notes:
- Squash-merged into main on 2026-03-03 after final approval by Ben Carlson.
- Merge commit references ENG-4192 and SUP-8921.

Operational runbook excerpt (ops/README): "If a region enters high lockdown counts, use `controlplane admin clear-lockdown --region <r>` to reset or `controlplane admin boost-budget --tenant <t> --seconds 600` to temporarily raise debt budget for critical tenants. Monitor tenant_degrade_budget_seconds_remaining and circuit_lockdown_duration_seconds."

Security/Privacy: No tenant data is exfiltrated. All decisions are statistical and telemetry is aggregated per-tenant id.

Observability: Dashboards added to console: Tenant Degrader Overview, Regional Circuit Lockdown heatmap.

Notes: Feature flag is conservative; recommend enabling for a small set of noisy tenants first. If any unexpected regressions happen, rollback by turning flag off.
